name: Motion kit — fonts, shapes, cursor, 3D
description: What Cupric's shapes library, cursor clicks, 3D tilt and rich captions build on: the video-grade fonts (all bundled, OFL) and the Javis.jl ideas (MIT, concepts only). Shapes and the cursor live in the Studio toolbar.

items.name: Javis.jl (concepts)
items.description: Julia animation framework. Cupric borrows its ideas, not its code: draw-on paths (Javis `appear(:draw_text)`), actions scheduled in frame ranges on objects, and parent/child object transforms — mapped to shape draw-on, per-clip keyframes and cursor→target linking.

data.promptCue: Reveal diagrams by drawing strokes on in sequence; schedule each action on a frame range; move children with their parent.

items.name: Montserrat (bold captions)
items.description: Geometric sans at weight 800 is the talking-head caption standard: wide, legible on phones. Bundled.

data.promptCue: Captions: Montserrat 800, 6–8% of frame height, white with a soft shadow; emphasise one word.

items.name: Instrument Serif (italic emphasis)
items.description: Condensed editorial serif; its italic is the ‘*woman* over 30’ emphasis word in creator edits. Bundled.

data.promptCue: Pair a heavy sans caption with ONE Instrument Serif italic word, tinted lilac or brand colour.

items.name: Bebas Neue (hype titles)
items.description: Tall condensed caps for hype titles, sports and countdowns. Bundled.

data.promptCue: Uppercase only, wide tracking (+4%), very large; never for body captions.

items.name: Anton (impact headlines)
items.description: Heavy condensed grotesque for punchy YouTube-style headlines. Bundled.

data.promptCue: Short 2–4 word headlines, stroke or box behind for contrast.

items.name: Poppins (friendly UI/explainers)
items.description: Rounded geometric sans for explainers and product videos. Bundled.

items.name: Outfit (modern SaaS)
items.description: Clean modern geometric for SaaS launches. Bundled.

items.name: Geist (product/tech)
items.description: Vercel's neutral tech sans; great for stats and product UI. Bundled.

data.promptCue: Numbers and product UI copy; pair with Geist Mono for code.
